hypothesis: The level of SG&A intensity measures cost discipline, but the stability of the single-quarter SG&A ratio measures whether that discipline is consistent. Stable cost ratios may reduce operating surprises and improve the durability of the R221 signal.

factor.formula: negative population standard deviation (ddof=0) of the latest four single-quarter (selling + management expense) / revenue ratios; higher is better
factor.quarterization: Q1 uses reported cumulative values; later quarters subtract the prior cumulative quarter; each quarter requires revenue > 0 and non-null selling and management expenses
factor.effective_date: maximum statutory disclosure deadline of the four quarters plus four calendar days
factor.point_in_time: statutory-deadline fallback; local 2021Q1-2026Q2 financial snapshots; no 2018-2020 restated data used
factor.missing_policy: no filling, no zero substitution, no fallback to the R221 SG&A level factor

universe.rule: historical HS300 members excluding industry_l1 in {银行, 非银金融}
universe.industry_source: current ext_hy_ths industry snapshot; not historical PIT

control_strategy.purpose: Same non-financial universe, SG&A-stability availability filter and execution; stability is not a score component.

execution.universe: historical non-financial HS300 membership; daily snapshots from 2022

samples.recent_12m: last 252 trading-day returns of the stitched 2022-2026 curve
samples.rolling_1y: 252-trading-day rolling compounded return over the stitched 2022-2026 curve

gates.D1: factor coverage within historical non-financial HS300 membership over 2022-2026 is at least 90%
gates.D2: first valid value occurs by 2022-06-30 and recent-12m coverage is at least 95%
gates.D3: mean absolute monthly cross-sectional Spearman correlation with the R221 SG&A level factor is at most 0.70
gates.G1: discovery 2022-2024 total return is at least control + 5pp
gates.G2: discovery 2022-2024 MDD is no worse than control by more than 2pp
gates.G3: validation 2025-2026 total return is at least control - 5pp
gates.G4: full-sample rolling-1y positive rate is at least control
gates.G5: full-sample MDD is no worse than control by more than 2pp
gates.G6: full-sample total return is at least control - 5pp
gates.G7: recent 12m total return is positive and recent 12m MDD is no worse than control by more than 2pp
gates.G9: candidate full-sample total return is at least the R221 SG&A-level candidate full-sample total return minus 5pp

decision_rule: All D and G gates must pass. The factor definition, non-financial universe, scoring weights, holding period and stop loss are frozen before factor construction. No post-result relaxation, filling, industry redefinition, or substitution with the R221 level factor is allowed.
known_limitations: The industry classification is a current snapshot, not a historical PIT industry series.
The financial tables are current snapshots; statutory deadlines are used because provider announcement dates are not reliable first-disclosure timestamps.
SG&A stability is related to the R221 level factor by construction; D3 measures the cross-sectional correlation explicitly.
The factor is research-only until every pre-registered gate passes.
